articles.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
articles.snippet: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.

articles.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
articles.snippet: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.

articles.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
articles.snippet: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard’s first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.

articles.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
articles.snippet: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
articles.snippet: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds—some 85 times faster.
